name: Poznań Game Arena
blurb: The largest computer, console and multimedia entertainment fair in Central and Eastern Europe, with esports, a cosplay show and creator meet-and-greets.

editions.evidence: Page title: 'Poznań Game Arena 2026 | 23-25th October 2026'; news text: 'the 20th anniversary edition of Poznań Game Arena is coming! From October 23-25, 2026, the MTP Poznań Expo will transform into the gaming capital of Europe'

notes: 2026 is PGA's 20th-anniversary edition. The site and a WebSearch both describe YouTubers/streamers/esports talent and a cosplay show as regular draws, but no individually named 2026 guest was found on the homepage or news listing, and WebSearch turned up only generic marketing copy (no names) — recorded as 'none-yet' rather than guessing names. Venue is the MTP (Międzynarodowe Targi Poznańskie / Poznań International Fair) exhibition grounds, confirmed via the site's own news text and partner links to mtp.pl.
